message: Dikhow river rising past danger level by +1.8m. Wards 4-7 instructed to evacuate immediately to Govt HS School shelter.
Continuous heavy precipitation expected (140mm/24hr). High vulnerability of hill slopes to saturation and landslides.
Dhansiri embankment structural weakening near Numaligarh. NDRF and SDRF teams deployed for emergency reinforcement.
Severe waterlogging across GS Road arterial link. Citizens advised to avoid underpasses and riverfront zones.
Subansiri river level overflowing low embankments. 14 villages in Bihpuria sector alerted for high water levels.
